description: Monsoon's signature dish in the bamboo belt: tender young bamboo shoots, sliced and cooked into a spiced curry, earthy, faintly tangy, unlike anything in mainstream Gujarati thalis. The shoots emerge with the rains, so July to September is the honest season; village kitchens and some Ahwa-side eateries make it, and campsite cooks will if asked when shoots are around. Pickled bamboo shoot extends the season in local homes.

where_to_try.name: Village kitchens and homestays in season

cultural_note: Bamboo is the material and the meal of these forests, harvest of shoots follows customary norms; the dish is forest knowledge on a plate.
